name: Laughing Sisters
summary: In Ashenvale, dryad hair is sought for an empowered robe. The experienced troll tailor Kil'hala at the Crossroads needs the enchanted locks to weave a mage robe, as Horde mages press against the woodland's native defenders.

sections.title: Weaving the Arcane
sections.body: After securing water from Xavian, rising mages are sent by Deino in Orgrimmar to help craft their own enchanted vestments. These arcane garments need materials touched by raw magic. Dryad locks carry the forest's ancient vitality, giving them what is needed to weave intricate robes that shield and strengthen a caster.

sections.title: Stalking Raynewood
sections.body: Mages seek the laughing sisters near Raynewood Retreat in Ashenvale. These nimble dryads ally with the night elves and fiercely guard their groves from woodsmen and outsiders. They will not willingly give their hair to Horde spellcasters, so the locks are taken by force beneath the ancient trees.

sections.title: The Weaver's Prerogative
sections.body: The locks travel south across the border to the dusty settlement of the Crossroads in the Barrens. There, troll tailor Kil'hala receives them without remorse. Kil'hala acknowledges the woodland creatures' loss with a touch of irony, then puts the enchanted strands to use, knowing Horde power demands resolve.

faq.q: Who assigns the quest to hunt the Laughing Sisters?
faq.answer: Deino, a troll mage at Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar, sends mages to gather what is needed for their mage class robes.
The laughing sisters are dryads, daughters of the demigod Cenarius. With night elf women's upper bodies and fawn-like lower bodies, they protect Ashenvale's woodlands and sacred clearings.

faq.q: Where can the laughing sisters be found?
faq.answer: They roam the forest near Raynewood Retreat and the Laughing Sister clearing in central Ashenvale, not far from the trade road.

faq.q: Why does Kil'hala need dryad hair?
faq.answer: Dryad hair carries natural enchantment, making it suitable thread for Kil'hala to weave into specialized robes that resonate with magic and suit the arcane arts.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the hair once it is collected?
faq.answer: Take the hair to Kil'hala, a tailor at the Crossroads in the Barrens.

faq.q: What happens after Kil'hala takes the hair?
faq.answer: Kil'hala works briefly with the hair, then offers Nether-lace Garment to finish the robe.

angles.text: As a mage, this rite of passage shows how even Ashenvale's sacred woodland spirits are harvested for arcane craft.
As a tailor, you see the rare art of weaving living magical fibers into cloth armor, using the high-level technique Kil'hala practices at the Crossroads.
As a member of the Horde, you strike at Ashenvale's dryads and deepen the conflict with the sacred forest guardians allied with the night elves.
